claims.content: Enable the Auctioneer to analyze auction-available inventory by category, cost, units, and unique SKUs, including aging and performance metrics, to support decisions on inventory management and auction scheduling.

goal.raw_text: Enable the Auctioneer to analyze auction-available inventory by category, cost, units, and unique SKUs, including aging and performance metrics, to support decisions on inventory management and auction scheduling.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer must have access to the Inventory Performance & Aging Report system.
The report criteria section must be available, including a 'search for auction items' search box with wildcard capability.
Radio button options must be available to choose between 'Items currently online only' and 'All sellable auction inventory'.
Radio buttons must be enabled for choosing 'Showing items with or without images' and 'Showing items with or without a valid (sellable) location.'
A Group By scrolling list box must be available with grouping options such as Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material, etc.
The Auctioneer opens the Inventory Performance & Aging Report from the Auction Admin Main Menu to analyze available auction inventory by category, cost, units, and unique SKUs.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer opens the Inventory Performance & Aging Report from the Auction Admin Main Menu to analyze available auction inventory by category, cost, units, and unique SKUs.

claims.content: The Auctioneer selects the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' option from the Reports Menu on the Auction Administration Main Menu page.
The system displays the Inventory Performance & Aging Report interface with the criteria section, including search options and grouping controls.
The Auctioneer uses the 'search for auction items' search box to enter keywords or wildcards (% or *) to filter inventory items.
The Auctioneer selects radio button options to choose between 'Items currently online only' or 'All sellable auction inventory'.
The Auctioneer enables radio buttons to specify whether to show items with or without images and with or without a valid (sellable) location.
The Auctioneer selects one or more grouping options from the Group By scrolling list box (e.g., Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material Purity, Brand, etc.).

The system generates and displays the report results based on user-selected criteria and grouping, showing columns such as Product ID, Active Date, Last Shown Date, Qty on Open Purchase Order, Last Receipt Date, Buyer Name, Item Description, Retail Category, Gemstone, Product Type, Brand, J/G Score, GM/TE, Cost, Has Image, Location, Available Total Company Inventory On Hand, Auction Available, White Total Qty, White Total Cost, Red Unsellable Total Quantity, and Red Unsellable Total Cost.
The Auctioneer reviews the displayed inventory data, including aging buckets and performance metrics, to assess availability and make management decisions.
If the Auctioneer selects 'Items currently online only', the system filters results to exclude items not part of available auction inventory, impacting the 'Red status' columns accordingly.
If the Auctioneer enables 'Showing items with or without images', the system includes or excludes items based on image availability in the JTV SuperNova system.
If the Auctioneer enables 'Showing items with or without a valid (sellable) location', the system includes or excludes items lacking a physical inventory location marked as sellable realm ('white').
If no grouping option is selected from the Group By list box, the system displays ungrouped results sorted by default criteria (e.g., Product ID or Active Date).
If the search box input contains invalid wildcard syntax, the system displays an error message and prompts the user to correct the search term before regenerating results.
If the search for auction items input contains invalid wildcard syntax (e.g., malformed % or *), the system displays an error message and halts report generation until corrected.
If no valid grouping option is selected from the Group By scrolling list box, the system defaults to ungrouped display but may issue a warning if user intended grouped analysis.

If filtering criteria result in zero matching items (e.g., ‘Items currently online only’ with no active listings), the system displays an empty results table with summary section showing all totals as zero.
If an item lacks a required field such as Product ID, Active Date, or Cost, the system excludes it from results and logs a data integrity exception for administrative review.

If ‘Red Unsellable Total Quantity’ or ‘Red Unsellable Total Cost’ exceeds threshold values defined by business rules (not specified in doc), the system flags the report with a red status banner indicating potential inventory risk.

The system has generated and displayed a report containing inventory data filtered by the Auctioneer's selected criteria (e.g., 'Items currently online only' or 'All sellable auction inventory', image availability, location validity).

The report results are grouped according to the Auctioneer's selection from the Group By scrolling list box (options include Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material, Brand, Inventory Realm, etc.).

The 'Results' section displays columns including Product ID, Active Date, Last Shown Date, Qty on Open Purchase Order (P.O.), Last Receipt Date, Buyer Name, Item Description, Retail Category, Gemstone, Product Type, Brand, J/G Score, GM/FTE, Cost, Has Image (Yes or No), Location, Available (Total Company Inventory On Hand), and Auction Available.
The report includes summary metrics for White Total Qty, White Total Cost, Red Unsellable Total Quantity, and Red Unsellable Total Cost.
The report provides visibility into currently available auction inventory as well as product that is NOT part of available auction inventory.
